pin_delta: The baseline uses the provider-neutral --files spelling for both direct-file comparisons; stable v0.20.1 uses positional paths.

test_mapping.source_test: comment navigation resumes from an unannotated hunk in stream order
real hunk navigation jumps to later hunks in the review stream
backward cross-file hunk navigation reveals the target hunk in a real PTY
PTY sessions can navigate forward and backward between distant hunks in one large file
sidebar selection jumps the main pane without collapsing the review stream
clicking a sidebar file pins that file header to the top in a real PTY

adaptations: Each translated case renders through Ratatui TestBackend at the source terminal dimensions and drives the same navigation keys or mouse target.
The cross-file test additionally checks the intermediate FileTop reveal: the short file's first hunk is visible while its distant second hunk remains outside the cell frame.
The renderer applies the shared FileTop, Hunk, and scroll-to-note requests to measured Ratatui row bounds, including the pinned 25-percent viewport padding policy.
Selection state is asserted alongside terminal content so coincidental visibility cannot satisfy a navigation transition.
